output.subject: We've received your complaint about app transfers
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for calling us about the trouble you had with our mobile app. We have received your complaint, and we want you to know it is being looked at.

You told us that last night you tried to move money from your savings account to your checking account in the app. You said each attempt failed with a "something went wrong" message, four times in total. You mentioned that no money moved and that your balances looked correct afterwards. We understand how frustrating it is when a routine transfer between your own accounts won't go through, especially after several tries, and we're sorry for the annoyance this has caused.

What you're asking for is simple: to be able to transfer money between your own accounts in the app without errors.

A specialist team is now reviewing your complaint, and we will respond to you within 10 business days.

Thank you for your patience, and for taking the time to let us know.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: The rep's note mentions a known issue with transfers over $250 after 10pm and a fix in progress. The draft leaves this out. Decide whether to share it or a workaround.
Confirm whether the customer still needs to make this transfer urgently and whether an alternative method should be offered.
Verify that no transfers posted or are pending and that the balances are correct, as the rep noted.
The transfer amount was not recorded in the note. Check whether it is relevant to the known issue.
This is ACKNOWLEDGE ONLY mode, so the draft takes no position on the cause or the fix timing.
